history.summary: A freehold 3BR (2015) in D15 East Coast asking $1,787 PSF (~3% over the $1,742 median) at a clean $2.0M — squarely in the liquid sweet spot. Strong arena record (352-176, Elo 1377) but only 12 URA transactions and a 1.16km MRT walk; a solid Neutral with constructive lean.
history.rating_rationale: $2.0M for a freehold East Coast 3BR is in the deepest liquidity band, and the arena loves it (352-176-41, Elo 1377 — top of batch). URA 4.46%/yr is healthy but rests on just 12 transactions, so reliability is low. Asking is +3% to median — fair, not cheap. 1.16km (14 min) to TE26 Marine Parade is a weak walk. D15 freehold family unit has a deep owner-occupier base, which protects the exit. Quality and liquidity offset thin appreciation data.
